### <span class="imp imp-high" title="Importance 7.5/10" aria-label="Importance 7.5 of 10">7.5</span> Scientists Deploy Sunflower Sea Stars to Restore California's Kelp Forests
Scientists are reintroducing captive-bred sunflower sea stars (critically endangered with up to 24 arms) into California's kelp forests, where approximately 95% of ecosystems have been decimated over the past decade. Off Monterey, researchers place the creatures in open-door cages to naturally resume their ecosystem role and help restore carbon-sequestering forests.

<ul class="takeaways">
<li>95% of Pacific coast kelp forests decimated over past decade</li>
<li>Sunflower sea stars can have up to 24 arms; species critically endangered</li>
<li>Kelp grows up to 2 feet per day, reaching heights taller than 10-story buildings</li>
<li>Kelp forests sequester approximately 200 million tons of CO2 annually worldwide</li>
<li>Restoration effort is first phase of reintroduction project near Monterey</li>
</ul>

Sources: [The Guardian](https://www.theguardian.com/environment/2026/oct/13/sunflower-sea-star-california-kelp-forests) <span class="src-badge src-research">AI Web Searched</span>, [The Guardian — Climate Crisis](https://www.theguardian.com/environment/2026/oct/13/sunflower-sea-star-california-kelp-forests) <span class="src-badge src-rss">RSS</span>, [The Guardian — Conservation](https://www.theguardian.com/environment/2026/oct/13/sunflower-sea-star-california-kelp-forests) <span class="src-badge src-rss">RSS</span>

### <span class="imp imp-high" title="Importance 7/10" aria-label="Importance 7 of 10">7</span> Trump administration eliminates endangered species habitat protections
The president of the United States administration finalized a rule on July 10, 2026, removing federal habitat protections for endangered species by rescinding the regulatory definition of 'harm' under the Endangered Species Act. The elimination opens species' habitats to logging, mining, oil and gas drilling, and other destruction.

<ul class="takeaways">
<li>Rule finalized July 10, 2026</li>
<li>Rescinded &#x27;significant habitat modification or degradation&#x27; definition</li>
<li>Removes decades of habitat protections for endangered species</li>
<li>Opens habitats to logging, mining, oil and gas drilling</li>
<li>Reverses Supreme Court precedent protecting old-growth forest for spotted owls</li>
<li>Affects species including spotted owls, Atlantic salmon, Florida panthers</li>
</ul>

Sources: [Center for Biological Diversity](https://news.google.?oc=5) <span class="src-badge src-research">AI Web Searched</span>
